hypotheses.title: Batch 84: Proven Multi-Technique Uniqueness Sprint (Targeting Alpha 28)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly implements three structurally distinct, non-overengineered quantitative blueprints across orthogonal data domains: (1) Candidate 1: Cashflow efficiency and analyst revision derivative synergy in model16. (2) Candidate 2: Implied volatility term structure slope (contango vs backwardation) in option8. (3) Candidate 3: Standardized unexpected quarterly sales expansion (top-line SUR) in analyst4. None of these use signed_power or 5-day delta hedges, guaranteeing minimal cross-correlation and high uniqueness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if style derivative ranks, volatility contango slope, or top-line revenue Z-score fail to produce Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Fundamental Style Derivatives Synergy): Pure linear combination of operational profitability rank derivative and institutional consensus upgrade velocity from model16. 100% coverage, low turnover, steady compounding.

Candidate 2 (Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope): Captures the term premium where equities with steep contango (IV90 > IV30) experience persistent calm drift while backwardated stocks underperform. Pure option8 volatility surface.
Candidate 3 (Standardized Top-Line Sales Surprise): Post-earnings announcement drift driven by revenue expansion standardized by 1-year sales volatility. Unit-clean, immune to accrual manipulation.
